nodes.label: ghost_vests
nodes.rationale: Pure content pack: 32 weapon/item classes with no scripted behaviour, so it ships only a stub function to satisfy the addon function-library skeleton.

nodes.label: ghost_main
nodes.rationale: Common root addon every ghost content pack requires; centralises shared macros and root config classes.

nodes.label: tools/gen_addon_readmes.py
nodes.rationale: Generates the Requires/Ships/Functions sections of every addon README from the actual config and function inventory, so the hand-written header stays authored while the manifest below the marker line is never edited by hand and cannot drift.

nodes.label: fnc_empty stub pattern
nodes.rationale: Content-only addons still carry a single no-op function so the CBA function-library / XEH_PREP skeleton is well-formed even when the addon has no scripted behaviour.

nodes.label: ghost_vests_aegis
nodes.rationale: Only 3 classes but spans three separate external mods (Aegis vests, Aegis RF vests, Western Sahara load order), so it is isolated behind skipWhenMissingDependencies.

nodes.label: skipWhenMissingDependencies
nodes.rationale: The PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when an external mod above it is absent - lets ghost ship optional third-party-dependent content packs in one distribution without forcing every user to subscribe to every source mod.

nodes.label: ghost_vests_efa
nodes.rationale: Largest vest pack (147 classes) generated over a single external source mod, so one missing dependency gates the whole PBO.

nodes.label: ghost_vests_sof
nodes.rationale: Unusual among the vest packs in also shipping 6 unit classes alongside the 6 vest classes - the units exist to expose the vests on wearable soldiers rather than as inventory items only.

nodes.label: ghost_vests_ws
nodes.rationale: Re-exposes Western Sahara CDLC vests so ghost factions can reference them; ships no new classes of its own, only the re-exposure plus a stub function.

nodes.label: ghost factions (consumers of re-exposed vests)
nodes.rationale: Faction addons cannot reference CDLC vest classes directly without inheriting the hard dependency; the vests_* wrapper packs give them a ghost-owned, skippable indirection layer.

nodes.label: ghost_vs17
nodes.rationale: The only addon in this group with real scripted behaviour: a VS-17 marker panel exposed both as a carryable inventory item and as a placeable world object.

nodes.label: Item/placeable-object duality
nodes.rationale: One piece of equipment is modelled as two config classes - an inventory item class and a world object class - with place/pick functions converting between them, so the panel can be carried in a vest and also deployed on the ground.

nodes.label: ghost_weapons
nodes.rationale: Adjusts base-game weapon classes in place rather than cloning them, so it depends only on vanilla A3 addons and carries no skipWhenMissingDependencies.
